skills.title: Researching Animals and Water
skills.description: Put the steps of a research in order. Pick a good question about animals or water and the best place to find the answer.

skills.title: Fair Tests With Solids and Liquids
skills.description: Pick the fair test that changes only one thing, like testing which things float. Put the steps of an experiment in order.

skills.title: Design, Build, and Test Machines
skills.description: Put the steps for making a simple device or structure in order. Pick what to change to make it work better.

skills.title: Safe Science Habits
skills.description: Pick the safe way to use tools and materials. Choose the right gear to wear for the job.

skills.title: Sharing Science Findings
skills.description: Pick the best way to share what you found for different people, like a chart or a talk. Match science words to what they mean.

skills.title: Break a Problem Into Steps
skills.description: Look at a few lines of code and pick what they will do. Pick the smaller steps that solve a big problem.

skills.title: How Coding Changes Daily Life
skills.description: Pick how coding and new technology change what people do every day. Tell the good changes from the tricky ones.

skills.title: Science Fixes Real Problems
skills.description: Match science and technology at home and in town to the problems they fix. Pick how science works with other subjects to solve problems.

skills.title: Science Ideas From Many Communities
skills.description: Match science and technology ideas to the communities that gave them to us. Pick how those ideas help people.

skills.title: Comparing Animal Features
skills.description: Compare how animals look, like their size, covering, and body parts. Sort features that stay the same from ones that change as the animal grows.

skills.title: How Animals Move
skills.description: Match animals to how they move, like walking, hopping, swimming, flying, or slithering.

skills.title: Animal Life Cycles
skills.description: Put the stages of a life cycle in order for an insect, a frog, a bird, and a mammal.

skills.title: How Animals Change as They Grow
skills.description: Compare how an animal looks and acts at each stage, like a caterpillar and a butterfly.

skills.title: Animal Adaptations
skills.description: Match animal body parts and behaviours, like thick fur or hiding, to how they help the animal survive where it lives.

skills.title: How Animals Affect People and Nature
skills.description: Pick ways animals help or cause problems for people and the environment. Pick ways to lessen the problems.

skills.title: People's Actions and Animal Homes
skills.description: Pick how things people do, like building roads or littering, affect animals and their homes. Choose actions that protect them.

skills.title: Liquid or Solid?
skills.description: Sort things in nature and in buildings and towns into liquids and solids.

skills.title: Properties of Liquids and Solids
skills.description: Pick how liquids and solids are different, like holding their shape or taking the shape of a container.

skills.title: Liquid Water and Ice
skills.description: Pick how liquid water and ice are different. Pick what makes water freeze or ice melt.

skills.title: When Do Liquids and Solids Change?
skills.description: Pick when a liquid or solid stays the same and when heat or cold makes it change, like chocolate melting.

skills.title: Useful Mixtures
skills.description: Pick how mixing liquids and solids makes useful things, like juice from powder or paint.

skills.title: Float, Sink, Soak, or Repel
skills.description: Sort solid things by whether they float or sink. Sort them by whether they soak up water or push it away.

skills.title: Safety Symbols on Products
skills.description: Match the safety symbols on cleaners and other products to what they mean.

skills.title: Using and Storing Things Safely at Home
skills.description: Pick safe ways to use, store, and throw away liquids and solids at home. Pick the choice that is best for health and nature.

skills.title: Freezing and Melting Effects
skills.description: Pick how freezing and melting, like icy roads or melting ice, affect people and places.

skills.title: Ways Objects Move
skills.description: Match objects to how they move, like straight, round and round, back and forth, or up and down.

skills.title: Changing an Object's Position
skills.description: Pick how to move an object to a new spot, like pushing, pulling, lifting, or rolling.

skills.title: The Six Simple Machines
skills.description: Name and pick the lever, inclined plane, wedge, pulley, wheel and axle, and screw from pictures.

skills.title: Simple Machines in Daily Life
skills.description: Match everyday tools, like ramps, scissors, and flagpoles, to the simple machine and the job it makes easier.

skills.title: Less Push With a Machine
skills.description: Pick which way takes less force to move an object, with a simple machine or without one.

skills.title: Machines Help People Everywhere
skills.description: Pick how simple machines help people do daily tasks in different communities.

skills.title: Machines and the Environment
skills.description: Pick how technologies with simple machines that help us move, like bikes and cranes, affect nature.

skills.title: Properties of Air and Water
skills.description: Pick key facts about air and water, like air takes up space and water flows and takes the shape of its container.

skills.title: Where Water Comes From
skills.description: Sort water sources in nature, like lakes and rivers, and built ones, like wells and taps.

skills.title: Three States of Water
skills.description: Sort water as solid, liquid, or gas in nature. Pick how warming and cooling change it.

skills.title: The Water Cycle
skills.description: Put the water cycle in order: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection.

skills.title: Living Things Need Air and Water
skills.description: Pick how plants, animals, and people use air and water to live.

skills.title: Keeping Air and Water Clean
skills.description: Pick how people's actions affect air and water, including how First Nations, Métis, and Inuit see it. Pick a plan to protect them.

skills.title: Using Water Wisely
skills.description: Pick how we use water at home. Choose a plan to use less, like turning off the tap.

skills.title: Fresh Water Around the World
skills.description: Pick where fresh and drinking water is easy or hard to get. Pick how this affects communities.
